observations: The page number «75» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «10*» on the right. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 74 (JP2 0106, L34), «mit 114 und teile das».

L05, L18 and L34: the formulas displayed and centred, their fractions built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}, as are the factors 114/115, 148/144, 57/115, 113/116, 103/126 and 1/3 within the lines; «8p 44′», «2p 28′», the p raised and italic; «·» the raised dot of multiplication; in L05 a wide gap after the semicolon that follows «(nach Tafel 60)».

L05-L11. Checked: 12 tg 36° = 8p 43′ 7″, so that the 8p 44′ that Suter reads in Table 60 is about a minute high; 524′ × 114 : 115 = 519.4′ = 8p 39′; with ε = 23° 51′ the right ascension of the end of Aries is 27° 50′ 10″ (Table 59: 117° 50′ less 90°, see p. 72, JP2 0104); 27° 50′ − 8° 39′ = 19° 11′; the ascensional difference by al-Battānī's formula with al-Khwārizmī's values, sin DN = tg 36° · tg 11° 39′ 50″, is 8° 37′ 34″, and the exact oblique ascension of Aries 19° 12′ 37″, Ptolemy's 19° 12′.

L12-L23. Checked: the declination of the end of Aries with ε = 23° 51′ is 11° 39′ 50″, as in Table 21; 12 tg 11° 39′ 50″ = 2p 28′ 38″, so that 2p 28′ is the tangent of Table 60 truncated; 8p 44′ · 2p 28′ · 60 : 144 = 8p 44′ · 148 : 144 = 8p 58′ 33″, «8p 59′»; the arc whose sine is 8p 59′ on a radius of 60 is 8° 36′ 39″, «8° 37′».

L24-L32. Checked: half of 8° 39′ is 4° 19½′, the arc for 15°, 57/115 of 8p 44′ (4° 19′ 43″); the right ascension of 15° of Aries is 13° 46′ 12″, and 13° 46′ − 4° 19½′ = 9° 26½′; the exact oblique ascension of 15° is 9° 23′ 7″. Taurus: the ascensional difference grows from 8° 37′ 34″ at the end of Aries to 15° 45′ 37″ at the end of Taurus, by 7° 8′ 3″, which is 0.8169 of 8p 44′, close to 103/126 = 0.8175, where 113/116 gives 8° 30′. Gemini: from 15° 45′ 37″ to 18° 44′ 8″ at the solstice, by 2° 58′ 31″, where a third of 8p 44′ is 2° 54′ 40″; the right ascension of the sign of Gemini, 90° − 57° 44′ 16″ = 32° 15′ 44″, less 2° 54′ 40″ is 29° 21′, Suter's value, and the exact oblique ascension of Gemini is 29° 17′ 13″, al-Battānī's 29° 17′.

L34. Checked: tg φ is the shadow of a gnomon of 12, so that sin δ · tg φ · 60 : (12 cos δ) = 60 tg δ tg φ : 12, the sine of the ascensional difference on a radius of 60, al-Battānī's formula of p. 74 (JP2 0106, L27).

L08: «Nach den Tafel Batt.’s», as printed. Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Batt.», «Ptol.», «Burgess», «Thibaut»; italics: «Ascensio obliqua», «Al-Raḳḳa», «DN», «Sūrya-Siddhānta», the letters of the formulas, «Transl.», «Panchasiddhāntikā».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-19 px measured).
